title: The scapegoat is partway up
notes: A perfect tree of seven keys, then a run of rising keys down the right edge. 97 lands at depth 6 with a limit of 5. Walking up, 95 and 90 are balanced enough, but 85's right child holds 3 of its 4 nodes, more than 2/3. Only 85's subtree is rebuilt; the rest of the tree is left alone.
